note: Built by Tools/Blender/bench_stage.py (Art's brief A1, specs/art-bench-and-cafe.md). THE FRAME: built in the InspectRig's own frame, not the house's front-faces--Y frame. Imported with no turn, its local +x is the player's right and +z is away from the player (Art's mat x, y), so it goes under the rig's stage with local rotation 0. Origin: the bottom centre (the mat's centre on the bench top). Unity (x, y, z) = Blender (-x, z, -y). The top is at y 0.005; the old slab's was 0.006: the InspectPoint goes 1 mm lower. Textured materials have a white base (the picture carries the colour); BM_Silicone's UVs are metres from the rulers' zero, so its tiling is 20 (a 50 mm tile). The empties are the auto-tray's places: Cup_1..6 on each cup's steel disc (1.8 mm up), Pad_* on the pad (5.3 mm), Well_* on the well's floor (2.0 mm); their names are a contract.

pieces.name: BM_RepairMat
pieces.what: silicone repair mat 600 x 360 x 5 mm: grid, two rulers, six screw cups with steel discs, a new-part pad, a cover well

collider.note: the slab; the cups and the well are recesses in it, so nothing may rely on physics to rest in them (the auto-tray places pieces by script)

pieces.place: a child of the InspectRig's 'Stage (v2)' at local (0, the bench top, -0.02) (today's mat: Playtest3Session4Steps.cs:103, matZ -0.02), local rotation 0, scale 1; it replaces the 'Mat' slab (switch the slab's renderer off, keep its collider while anything still falls)

camera.note: lens to the left; v3.6 strap: lugs at both ends, the runs 28-38 mm out, the loop 88 x 58 behind the lens half (device x -96..-8, y +66..+124)

BM_Silicone.why: the mat's slate-blue silicone with its printed 10 mm grid; the top is mapped in metres from the rulers' zero, the tile is 50 mm, so tiling 20

BM_Recess.why: the cups' walls, the cover well's walls and floor: a deeper blue (shadowed silicone)

BM_Pad.why: the pale new-part pad and the cups' floors: dark screws and parts read on it

BM_Print.why: the two printed ruler strips (cream ticks and numbers on the blue; the texture carries both colours, so the material's base is white)

BM_Ink.why: the cups' numbers and the pad's corner marks, raised print

BM_Steel.why: the steel disc in each cup's floor (the magnetic insert; BT_Steel's values)
